scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck:api && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
